name: Java
description: Java is the bedrock of enterprise software. It powers Android apps, backend systems, big data pipelines (Apache Hadoop, Spark), and financial infrastructure worldwide. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Introduction to Programming Using Java (Javanotes)
items.description: A free comprehensive online textbook covering OOP, GUI applications, and data structures.

items.title: Java Language Specification (JLS)
items.description: The definitive technical definition of Java from Oracle detailing syntax, types, and execution rules.

items.title: Dev.java — Official Oracle Learning Platform
items.description: The definitive destination for modern Java developers with hundreds of tutorials covering everything from your first app to Virtual Threads.

items.title: The Java Tutorials (Oracle)
items.description: Practical guides covering language basics, collections, concurrency, I/O, networking, and GUI programming.

items.title: Java SE Documentation
items.description: Complete API documentation, release notes, and migration guides for all Java SE versions.

items.title: Java Programming — University of Helsinki (MOOC.fi)
items.description: Widely regarded as the best free Java course with rigorous auto-graded projects covering OOP, algorithms, and data structures.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — Java Course
items.description: A comprehensive free course covering Java fundamentals, OOP principles, exception handling, and generics.

items.title: Java Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A multi-hour video tutorial covering Java from scratch: syntax, OOP, collections, file I/O, and multithreading.

items.title: Java Programming — Bro Code Full Course
items.description: A massive full-length course with clear, beginner-friendly explanations and hands-on coding examples.

items.title: Exercism — Java Track
items.description: 100% free with 158+ coding exercises across 24 concepts. Includes automated code analysis and human mentorship.

items.title: HackerRank — Java Domain
items.description: Practice Java-specific syntax, data structures, and algorithms tailored for coding interviews.

items.title: Codewars — Java Kata
items.description: Solve community-created kata in Java across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: Java Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise one-page reference covering Java syntax, data types, control flow, OOP, and standard library classes.

items.title: Baeldung Java Guides
items.description: Extensive collection of practical Java tutorials covering Spring, Hibernate, core Java, and testing.

items.title: Java Weekly (Baeldung)
items.description: A highly curated weekly roundup of technical deep dives, performance best practices, and release updates.

items.title: Inside Java (Oracle)
items.description: Direct updates and articles from the engineers building Java covering JDK enhancements and JEPs.

items.title: Reddit r/java
items.description: The primary discussion hub for enterprise Java news and ecosystem discussions.

items.title: Reddit r/learnjava
items.description: Dedicated beginner community for Java learners with Q&A and resource recommendations.

items.title: Java Discord Community
items.description: One of the largest active real-time Java communities for troubleshooting and peer learning.
